title: Compressing History into Memory: Distilling Transformers into Recurrent Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2606.21562v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Transformers are AI's workhorse but their computational cost becomes prohibitive when processing long sequences. We target long-horizon streaming vision and robotics applications, where it is particularly impractical to store and maintain a history of observations. Recurrent Transformers address this limitation by maintaining fixed-size memory but their performance lags behind that of transformers operating over the full observation history. We argue that this gap does not stem from architectural limitations, but from differences in how these models learn to compress past information. Without access to an observation history, recurrent models must explicitly decide what to retain in memory at each step, a significantly harder learning problem. translated_title: 将历史压缩进记忆：将Transformer蒸馏为循环Transformer
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.21562v2 公告类型：replace-cross。摘要：Transformer是人工智能领域的主力模型，但其在处理长序列时的计算成本会变得难以承受。我们面向长时程流式视觉与机器人应用，在这类场景中存储和维护观测历史尤其不切实际。循环Transformer通过维护固定大小的记忆来解决这一局限，但其性能落后于在完整观测历史上进行运算的Transformer。我们认为这一差距并非源于架构上的限制，而是源于这些模型学习压缩过去信息的方式不同。由于无法访问观测历史，循环模型必须在每一步显式决定应在记忆中保留什么，这是一个难度大得多的学习问题。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种蒸馏方法，将经典的全历史Transformer的压缩策略迁移到循环变体中。我们通过设计一个教师模型来实现这一目标……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种蒸馏方法，将处理完整历史的Transformer所学会的压缩策略迁移到循环Transformer中，从而在无需存储观测历史的情况下，显著提升循环模型在长时程流式视觉与机器人任务中的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a distillation approach that transfers the compression strategy learned by a full-history transformer to a recurrent transformer, significantly improving recurrent models' performance on long-horizon streaming vision and robotics tasks without storing observation history.
